# Lunar Lake unary fixture

Generated locally on 2026-10-03: Core Ultra 7 258V, vendor/device `8086:643e`,
driver `32.0.100.5540`, graph compiler `8.3`, npunlock native wheel 2026-09-28.00.

`abs-1x17.blob` is a single static FP16 Abs carrier generated by
`npunlock.npu4000.compile_unary((1,17), kernel).ir_provenance.graph_blob`.
It contains four tile groups with 16-element and 1-element tail invocations.
`add1.4000xx.elf` was compiled from `add1-fp16.c` using MoviTools target 4000xx
and npunlock's existing linker script. The Windows worker and proprietary
toolchain are not part of this fixture.

SHA-256:

- Kernel ELF: `ce69a18d414ea66814ac464eafa376d178dc326bb5b010cbef40d5c37b8d0661`
- Original Abs text: `5b51680501c037dfeb9fe4653df9d453fd5b42224681b41338b6de591d225a9d`

Run the offline check with `python -m unittest discover -s tests/python`.
Hardware checks are separate; passing a fixture check alone does not prove
support for other device, compiler, driver, or kernel profiles.

The precision extension adds abs-f32-1x17.blob and power-f16-1x17.blob,
compiled with accuracy mode and DisablePrecisionConversion metadata on the
same machine. arithmetic.c was compiled for 4000xx with -O2 -ffp-contract=off.
precision/ contains ELF and assembly for FP16/FP32 add1, neg, abs, sign, add,
sub, mul, div and casts. manifest.json records source, ELF and assembly hashes.

Rebuild with the workspace script npunlock-probe/research/build_precision_kernels.py
in the existing npunlock environment. It uses the isolated Movi worker.
IEEE subnormal edge paths execute integer arithmetic on SHAVE; ordinary FP32
arithmetic uses SAU.f32. FP16 conversion uses integer bit packing because
the tested hardware conversion paths flush subnormals.

resident/ adds sum/mean kernels built from arithmetic.c's FP32 helpers plus
resident_reduce.c, using the same 4000xx toolchain. Its manifest records both
source hashes and ELF/assembly hashes. Raw ReduceSum/ReduceMean (3,5), axis 1,
keep_dims=True and FP16 halfcode StridedSlice (17,2)->(17,1) fixtures were
compiled on the same profile. The reduction carrier checks reject partial
reduction extents; halfcode compaction must be DMA-only. The FP16 transport
preserves bits rather than numerically converting them.
Rebuild with npunlock-probe/research/build_resident_kernels.py from the workspace.
sum/mean now use FP32 Neumaier compensation to reduce cancellation and downstream
FP16/ReLU rounding sensitivity. Inf/NaN and subnormal behavior remain covered by
hardware regressions; source, ELF and assembly hashes were regenerated together.

resident/broadcast-f16-1x5-to-3x5.blob is a DMA-only Broadcast fixture.
The f32 counterpart transports logical (1,5)->(3,5) FP32 values as FP16 storage
words with physical shapes (1,5,2)->(3,5,2). It performs no numeric conversion.
Both use the same hardware/driver/compiler profile; offline checks reject
compute-task carriers and invalid broadcast dimensions.
